symptom: determine_final_status accepted showstopper=True as a caller assertion without requiring evidence of failed recovery, exhausted alternatives, or an irreducible blocker.
root_cause: The closure primitive modeled SHOWSTOPPER as a boolean input before modeling evidence-backed stop-decision integrity.
early_signals: MOCATRIZ canon requires reasonable recovery attempts before SHOWSTOPPER
no test distinguished viable alternative, WAITING_HUMAN, BLOCKED and justified SHOWSTOPPER
human_cost: A premature terminal decision can unnecessarily transfer unresolved work to the user or abandon a recoverable objective.
prevention_rule: SHOWSTOPPER requires a stop assessment proving failed/partial recovery, exhaustion of known viable alternatives, no available human resolution, and a material irreducible blocker.
automated_detection: SCN-046 self-regulation regression tests in schemas/tests/test_mocatriz_execution.py.
